title: Pokemon TCG Growing Grass Energy Perfect Order 086/088 Reverse Holofoil Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Rare English language Pokemon card from the Perfect Order set. It features the Growing Grass Energy card with a special attribute, Special Grass Energy. The card is part of the Pokemon TCG game and is manufactured by The Pokemon Company in the United States. It has a Reverse Holofoil finish and is not commonly seen in collections, making it a sought-after and valuable addition for collectors of Pokemon cards.
